_comment: Environment variable -> where its value comes from. Names only; values live in Key Vault (secret name = the variable lower-cased with dashes). 'dotenv' values are copied by infra/scripts/push_secrets.py, 'generated' ones are created once and never overwritten, 'azure' ones are written by the Bicep deployment.

APP_KEY.note: One per environment. Losing it makes 2FA secrets and encrypted columns unreadable: keep an offline copy.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.note: Signing secret of THIS environment's webhook endpoint in the Stripe dashboard (Asana story 11). The local one from `stripe listen` is useless here.

NAMECHEAP_API_USER.note: Both the live and the sandbox Namecheap API need a whitelisted IP; stage has no fixed outbound IP and uses DOMAIN_LOOKUP=whois.
